elements.evidence: Rendered Article X(b) still binds both parties: "neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party ... who was directly involved in such services", so Licensee (Customer) remains subject to a non-solicit.
"neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party and/or its Affiliates" replaces the one-way "the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor".

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Restriction limited to persons "who was directly involved in such services", i.e. "the services under this Agreement", replacing "any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates".

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: "Until 12 months after the end of an individual's involvement in the services under this Agreement" replaces "During the Term ... and during the three year period after the expiration or termination"; deterministic duration check value=12.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Retained verbatim: "shall not mean generally advertising job openings".

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Retained verbatim: "or any activities that constitute follow-up to individuals who respond to job opening advertisements or who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries".

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: Operative verb is limited to "solicit", defined as "affirmative recruitment specifically aimed at one or more individuals identified by name, title or affiliation"; no "employ or engage" or no-hire language exists in the original or rendered text.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: Element belongs to the fallback checklist only; the preferred checklist contains a single element (no non-solicit on Customer), which is not met.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: mutuality, scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services, a 12-month tail keyed to the end of that individual's involvement, and the pre-existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs retained verbatim; no employ/engage or no-hire language is introduced or retained.

Preferred level is not met because a non-solicit continues to bind Licensee (Customer); that is acceptable since the position is complete at the fallback, and the comment correctly frames this as the negotiated landing point.

Minimal: the edit touches only the temporal anchor, the party direction and the personnel scope — the three failing elements — and leaves the favourable 'Solicit' definition and carve-out sentence untouched. No survival tail, remedy, procedure or other extra requirement is added.

Intent preserved: the defined terms Licensor/Licensee are replaced by symmetric 'either party/other party' references that remain internally coherent, 'Affiliates' retains its Article 1.1 definition, and no cross-reference, remedy or timing mechanic elsewhere depends on the deleted three-year tail.

Note for the drafter (not a defect): the trigger 'end of an individual's involvement in the services' is self-defining within the clause, but if the parties want certainty you could anchor it to the completion of that person's assignment under the applicable order or statement of work.
